mapper.update: UPDATE book SET available_num = available_num - 1 WHERE id = #{bookId} AND status = 1 AND available_num > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, 1)
mapper.sql: ORDER BY (r.status = 1) DESC, (r.status = 1 AND r.due_time < NOW()) DESC, r.borrow_time DESC
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) AS user_name, r.book_id, b.name AS book_name, b.isbn AS book_isbn, b.cover_url AS book_cover_url, r.borrow_time, r.due_time, r.return_time, r.status, r.renew_count FROM borrow_record r LEFT JOIN book b ON b.id = r.book_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id
LIMIT #{startIndex}, #{dto.pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS borrowing_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND due_time < NOW() THEN 1 END) AS overdue_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 END) AS total_count FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET available_num = available_num + 1 WHERE id = #{bookId} AND available_num < total_num
